image_description: A group of Australian Pelicans standing on a sandy shore next to blue water. The pelicans have white bodies with black flight feathers, long pinkish bills with large gular pouches, and webbed feet. One pelican is in the foreground left, another in the center-right, and parts of others are visible on the edges.
